description: Modify an existing event or entire recurring series; individual expanded occurrences are not supported. Target it by resource_id or by calendar_id with uid. Omitted patch fields are preserved, null clears nullable fields, an empty alarms array removes alarms, and expected_etag can prevent a stale write.

calendar_id.description: Opaque calendar ID returned by list_calendars. Provide it together with uid when resource_id is unavailable.

expected_etag.description: ETag previously returned for the event. When supplied, the update fails if the event changed since it was read.

patch.description: Fields to replace. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears nullable values and an empty alarms array removes all alarms.

alarms.description: Replacement alarm set; use an empty array to remove all alarms.

items.description: A display reminder attached to an event.

action.description: Alarm action; only DISPLAY is supported.

description.description: Optional notification text for this alarm.

minutes_before.description: Whole minutes before the event start; use 0 for an alarm at start time.

description.description: Replacement notes; use null to clear the description.

anyOf.description: A timed calendar value with an explicit offset and IANA timezone.

date_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the local event time; its offset must match date_time.

end.description: Replacement end; provide together with start. An all-day end date is exclusive.

location.description: Replacement location; use null to clear it.

rrule.description: Replacement RFC 5545 recurrence rule without RRULE:, or null to make the event non-recurring.

anyOf.description: A timed calendar value with an explicit offset and IANA timezone.

date_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the local event time; its offset must match date_time.

start.description: Replacement start; provide together with end.

resource_id.description: Opaque event resource ID returned by list_events or get_event. Provide it alone instead of calendar_id and uid.

uid.description: iCalendar UID of the event. Provide it together with calendar_id when resource_id is unavailable.
